:::{#def-quadratic-model}
#### Quadratic approximation, quadratic model, second-order Taylor polynomial

Let $f$ be as in @def-newton-method and let $\vx$ be a point,
with $\vecf{g} \eqdef \deriv{\vx} f(\vx)$ and $\matr{H} \eqdef \matr{H}_f(\vx)$.
The **quadratic approximation** of $f$ at $\vx$ is the function of a step $\stepvec \in \reals^p$

$$
\quadmodelf{\stepvec} \eqdef f(\vx) + \dprod{\vecf{g}}{\stepvec} + \tfrac{1}{2}\,\tp{\stepvec} \matr{H} \stepvec,
$$

also called the **quadratic model** or the **second-order Taylor polynomial** of $f$ at $\vx$.

:::
